title: Good Night Oppy

ai_content.desc_en: In the film 'Good Night Oppy', we see a great story about the discovery of a new planet, where a team of scientists and researchers in the field of outer space encounter a strange being called 'Oppy', which has unique features, and they conduct research to uncover the secrets of this planet, as they face many dangers, and conduct surveillance and investigation on this new planet.
